hook: Hafeezpet painting shop fire at *5 am*, nobody hurt
hook_b: Hafeezpet painting shop fire at *5 am*, nobody hurt
tldr: A painting shop in Hafeezpet caught fire around 5 am on Saturday; fire crews controlled it and stopped it from spreading.

beats.what: Flames engulfed the shop around 5 am; fire personnel from Kukatpally and Patancheru fought the blaze.
beats.why: The shop was closed at the time, which is why there were no casualties.
beats.care: The extent of property damage is not yet known and fire officials are investigating the cause.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The blaze was kept from spreading to adjacent establishments.

cards.q: Shops with paint and chemicals: what matters most?

qs: What fire-safety checks apply to shops storing paint?
Why did crews come from Patancheru as well as Kukatpally?

facts.t: *No casualties* were reported because the shop was closed when the fire broke out.

viz.verdict: Shop was shut, so no one was hurt; damage not yet assessed

watch: The fire department's finding on what caused the blaze.

fact: A *5 am* fire gutted a Hafeezpet painting shop, but nobody was hurt
twist: Crews had to come from *two* stations, Kukatpally and Patancheru, to stop it reaching next-door shops.
